name: tunnel-and-sweep
title: Tunnel and Sweep a New Segment
description: Stand up a pivot from a proven foothold and enumerate the segment it exposes. Pick ONE tunnel method (the applicable one is ready; the rest skip or wait for approval), then scan an internal host through the proxy. A proven tunnel auto-extends scope to the exposed subnet — the hard gate stays enforced, never bypassed. Each step runs through the one scope-enforced runner.

steps.label: Pivot: SSH dynamic port-forward (SOCKS)
steps.note: The simplest pivot when you have SSH creds on the foothold — a SOCKS proxy over the SSH session.

steps.label: Pivot: sshuttle transparent tunnel (alternative)
steps.note: A transparent, route-based alternative over SSH — no per-tool proxychains needed.

steps.label: Pivot: Chisel reverse SOCKS (no-SSH alternative)
steps.note: When there's no SSH: stage chisel and open a reverse SOCKS tunnel back through the listener.

steps.label: Scan an internal host through the proxy
steps.note: Once a tunnel is up (scope auto-extended to the exposed subnet), enumerate a host on the far side.
